title: Keyword Research Fundamentals
content: Keyword research is the foundation of SEO. It helps you understand what your audience is searching for and how to optimize your content.
guidelines: Start with seed keywords related to your business
Use keyword research tools (Google Keyword Planner, Ahrefs, SEMrush)
Look for long-tail keywords with lower competition
Group keywords by topic and intent
